arXiv:2604.19672v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 4 月 21 日arXiv:2604.19672v1 [cs.LG] 21 Apr 2026

预算在线影响力最大化Budgeted Online Influence Maximization

Pierre Perrault    Jennifer Healey    Zheng Wen    Michal Valko
摘要Abstract

我们引入了一种新的在线影响力最大化预算框架，考虑广告活动的总成本，而不是对所选影响者集的常见基数约束。我们的方法更好地模拟了现实世界的环境，其中影响者的成本各不相同，广告商希望为其整体社交广告预算找到最佳价值。我们提出了一种假设独立级联扩散模型和边缘级半强盗反馈的算法，并提供了理论和实验结果。我们的分析对于基数约束设置也有效，并改善了这种情况下最先进的遗憾界限。We introduce a new budgeted framework for online influence maximization, considering the total cost of an advertising campaign instead of the common cardinality constraint on a chosen influencer set. Our approach models better the real-world setting where the cost of influencers varies and advertizers want to find the best value for their overall social advertising budget. We propose an algorithm assuming an independent cascade diffusion model and edge-level semi-bandit feedback, and provide both theoretical and experimental results. Our analysis is also valid for the cardinality-constraint setting and improves the state of the art regret bound in this case.

在线影响力最大化，土匪Online influence maximization, bandits

1 简介Introduction

现在，通过在线社交网络进行的病毒式营销占据了许多数字广告预算的重要组成部分。在这种形式的营销中，公司激励社交网络（例如 Facebook、Twitter、YouTube）中选定的有影响力的人推荐产品，希望他们的追随者能够采用该产品并将推荐重新发布到他们自己的追随者网络。 所选影响者集的有效性可以通过由于他们的初始推荐而采用该产品的预期用户数量来衡量，称为Viral marketing through online social networks now represents a significant part of many digital advertising budgets. In this form of marketing, companies incentivize chosen influencers in social networks (e.g., Facebook, Twitter, YouTube) to feature a product in hopes that their followers will adopt the product and repost the recommendation to their own network of followers. The effectiveness of the chosen set of influencers can be measured by the expected number of users that adopt the product due to their initial recommendation, called the传播spread. 影响力最大化Influence maximization（即时消息，(IM,Kempe et al.,, 2003）的问题是 选择影响者的最佳集合，以在所选集合的基数约束下最大化传播。) is the problem of choosing the optimal set of influencers to maximize the spread under a cardinality constraint on the chosen set.

备注1Remark 1.

此 OIM 包含总预算This OIM with a total budgetBB与之前工作中的OIM有所不同，比如is different from OIM in previous work, such asWang and Chen, (2017)，即使我们将所有成本设置为相等。在我们的设置中，所有轮次只有一个总预算，并且该策略可以在每一轮中自由选择不同成本的种子集，而在之前的工作中，每轮对于所选种子的数量/成本都有固定的预算。因此，我们的设置避免使用每轮预算，这实际上比全球预算更难建立, even when we set all costs to be equal. In our setting, there is only one total budget for all rounds, and the policy is free to choose seed sets of different cost in each round, whereas in the previous work, each round had a fixed budget for the number/cost of seeds selected. Our setting thus avoid the use of a budget per round, which is in practice more difficult to establish than a global budgetBB。尽管如此，正如我们将在一节中看到的. Nevertheless, as we will see in section6，当真实成本已知时，可以同时考虑两种类型的约束（全局约束和每轮约束）。, both types of constraints (global and per round) can be considered simultaneously when the true costs are known.

8 讨论和未来的工作Discussion and Future work

我们引入了一个新的预算 OIM 问题，在种子选择中同时考虑了影响者的成本和固定成本，而不是通常的基数约束。这更好地代表了当前病毒式营销面临的挑战，因为顶级影响者的成本往往越来越高。我们的固定成本也可以看作是一轮所花费的时间：零固定成本意味着重新加载网络以获得新的独立实例是We introduced a new Budgeted OIM problem, taking both the costs of influencers and fixed costs into account in the seed selection, instead of the usual cardinality constraint. This better represents the current challenges in viral marketing, since top influencers tend to be more and more costly. Our fixed cost can also be seen as the time that a round takes: A null fixed cost would mean that reloading the network to get a new independent instance is免费free和and瞬时的instantaneous.777在这种情况下，使用In this case, using|S|\mathopen{}\mathclose{{\left|S}}\right|每次轮次选择一个不同的影响者rounds choosing each time a single different influenceri∈Si\in S比选择整体要好is better than choosing the wholeSS在单轮比赛中。in a single round.显然，这是不现实的。 我们还提供了 IC 模型下的 Budgeted OIM 算法和边缘级半强盗反馈设置。Obviously, this is not realistic. We also provided an algorithm for Budgeted OIM under the IC model and the edge level semi-bandit feedback setting.

未来有趣的研究方向是探索预算 OIM 的其他类型的反馈或扩散模型。 对于实际的可扩展性，最好研究一下合并 线性泛化框架Interesting future directions of research would be to explore other kinds of feedback or diffusion models for Budgeted OIM. For practical scalability, it would also be good to investigate the incorporation of the linear generalization framework(Wen et al.,, 2017)纳入预算 OIM。注意，这个扩展是into Budgeted OIM. Notice, this extension is不not如果我们想保持更严格的信心区域，那就很简单了。 更准确地说，我们相信straightforward if we want to keep our tighter confidence region. More precisely, we believe that a线性半老虎机linear semi-bandit应开发意识到边缘观察之间的独立性的方法（线性泛化方法approach that is aware of independence between edge observations should be developed (the linear generalization approach ofWen et al., (2017)将每个边缘观察视为treats each edge observation as任意相关arbitrary correlated).

除此之外， 探索如何使用 FactIn addition to this, exploring how the use of Fact2 在算法中in the Algorithm仍然使用事实给出的置信区域时可以避免might be avoided while still using confidence region given by Fact1肯定会改进算法。一种可能的方法是使用 Thompson 采样 (TS) 方法would surely improve the algorithms. One possible way would be to use a Thompson Sampling (TS) approach(Wang and Chen,, 2018; Perrault et al., 2020a, )，其中先验考虑了权重的相互独立性。然而，, where the prior takes into account the mutual independence of weights. However,Wang and Chen, (2018)在他们的定理 2 中证明，TS 对于某些特殊的近似算法给出了线性近似遗憾。 因此，我们必须使用proved in their Theorem 2 that TS gives linear approximation regret for some special approximation algorithms. Thus, we would have to use some specific property of the贪婪的greedy我们使用的近似算法。approximation algorithm we use.
